our_interpretation: The period is February 15–29, 2024, following the post's description of the preceding two weeks.
The ordinary reading is that Kambhampati's group had recently presented empirical findings showing that chain-of-thought prompting was sensitive to changes in tasks, examples, or problem complexity.
Casting doubt requires a documented limitation in tested settings; it does not require proving that chain-of-thought prompting never helps.
A paper, dated presentation, or research announcement can establish that results were available. Formal publication is not required.
criteria.support_condition: A dated record establishes that Kambhampati's group presented new results during the target period showing failures of chain-of-thought prompting to generalize reliably across relevant variations.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The identifiable contemporaneous results were materially misdescribed: they did not test chain-of-thought robustness or did not report the claimed limitation. Failure to locate the results alone does not establish contradiction.
